title: Tim and the Big Bin
learning_objectives: Decode CVC words with short i
Keep reading short-a words from the earlier book
parent_prompts: New sound: short i as in tin, lid, big. Let the child stretch it: t-i-n.
Cover the picture if the child guesses. The words carry the story.
After reading: What did Tim do when the lid did not fit? Was that a good idea?

pages.illustration_brief: Tim (new: child with a red cap) standing next to a tall green bin taller than his waist; nothing in the bin visible.

pages.text: Tim puts a tin in the bin. Tin, tin, tin.
pages.illustration_brief: Tim dropping small cans into the bin one by one.
pages.audio_script: Tim puts a tin in the bin. Tin, tin, tin.

pages.text: The bin is full. The lid will not fit!
pages.illustration_brief: The bin heaped over the top; the lid perched crooked on the pile.
pages.audio_script: The bin is full. The lid will not fit!

pages.text: Tim sits on the lid. It dips. It tips!
pages.illustration_brief: Tim sitting on the lid, bin leaning to one side, cans starting to spill.
pages.audio_script: Tim sits on the lid. It dips. It tips!

pages.text: Tin, tin, tin. Tim gets the tins. He bins the tins.
pages.illustration_brief: Cans on the floor, Tim gathering them into his arms.
pages.audio_script: Tin, tin, tin. Tim gets the tins. He bins the tins.

pages.text: Tim gets a bag. Six tins in the bin, six tins in the bag. The lid fits!
pages.illustration_brief: Tim with the lid flat on the bin and a full cloth bag beside it, thumbs up.
pages.audio_script: Tim gets a bag. Six tins in the bin, six tins in the bag. The lid fits!

quiz.explanation: l-i-d. The middle sound is short i, and the last sound is d.

quiz.prompt: Why will the lid not fit?
quiz.explanation: Page 3 says: The bin is full. The lid will not fit!

quiz.prompt: Why does Tim get a bag at the end?

options.text: To hold some of the tins

quiz.explanation: Sitting on the lid made the bin tip (page 4). Putting half the tins in a bag let the lid fit (page 6).

quiz.prompt: Tell a grown-up what Tim tried first and what worked in the end.
quiz.rubric: not yet: says bin or tin only; with support: says he sat on it, with prompting; independent: sat on the lid, it tipped, then used a bag so the lid fit
quiz.explanation: Naming the failed try and the fix shows the child followed the problem and solution.

items.text: Tim fills the bin with tins.
Tim sits on the lid and it tips.
Tim puts some tins in a bag.

activities.prompt: Match the word to its meaning.

off_screen_prompt: Find something at home with a lid. Take it off and put it back. Say lid, l-i-d.

review.decodability_note: Short-i CVC: Tim, big, bin, tin(s), lid, fit(s), sit(s), dip(s), tip(s), six, bins (verb); short-a: bag. Sight words added to the irregular list for this book: puts, has, will, not, full, up, gets (each appears in the story; introduce before reading). Checker flags nothing further.
